title: IELTS API: a free, no-authentication REST API and open dataset for IELTS preparation research
description: Archived release of the IELTS API source code and datasets: Cambridge IELTS 1-22 vocabulary, analytic band descriptors, score concordances, exhaustive raw-score to band-score conversion tables with per-boundary provenance, the complete Listening and Reading question-type taxonomy, test-format blueprints, Writing and Speaking task banks, and a metadata index of an open IELTS research corpus. Cite this record, or the version-specific DOI, when you use the API or the datasets in research.
